beats.say: One classic coding round sits in most loops.
It is a filter. A great design round does not save a failed coding round.
beats.label: Why it matters
beats.head: A filter round

beats.say: The good news: most questions come from a small set of patterns.
beats.label: The good news
beats.head: A small set of patterns

check.prompt: The input has one million items. Which solution does the interviewer expect?
check.why: Two nested loops over a million items are a trillion steps. One pass or a sort is the target.

beats.say: The size tells you the speed the interviewer wants.
beats.label: A hidden hint
beats.head: The size is a hint

beats.say: Up to a thousand items, two loops are fine. Up to a million, you need one pass, or a sort.
beats.label: Size to speed
items: About 1,000,000: one pass or a sort

check.prompt: Find the longest part of a string with no repeated letter. Which pattern?
check.why: A window grows to the right, and shrinks from the left when a letter repeats.

beats.say: Second: solve it in one pass.
A hash map remembers what you saw. So you never search the array again.
beats.label: Hash map
beats.head: Remember what you saw

beats.say: Two pointers walk in from both ends of a sorted array.
beats.label: Two pointers
beats.head: Walk in from both ends

beats.say: A sliding window grows and shrinks over the array. Use it for the longest or the shortest part.
beats.label: Sliding window
beats.head: Grow and shrink a window

beats.say: Third: a few more patterns to know.
A stack finds the nearest match. A heap keeps the top k. Binary search cuts the space in half.
beats.label: Three tools

beats.say: For tasks that depend on other tasks, sort the graph. That is topological sort.
beats.label: Graphs
beats.head: Order tasks: topological sort

beats.say: Last: a method for the 45 minutes.
Restate the problem. Give a simple solution first. Improve it. Then test with a small example.
beats.label: Every time

beats.say: Quick recap of the coding round.
Read the size. Know the patterns. And always say the simple solution first.
beats.label: Coding rounds

beats.say: Now start the first lesson below.
